auth: Google-login bearer (require_google_user). Read only: no agent run, no mail, no DB write.
owner_scope: work_cases, quote_versions, suppliers and the initial mail are all filtered by the caller's owner_user_id. A missing or another user's case returns the same 404.

response.envelope: {data: {case_id, items[]}, meta: {request_id}}. case_id is kept for symmetry with API-14.
response.numbers: unit_price, available_quantity, moq.quantity and costs[].amount are Decimal strings without trailing zeros or exponent ('5500', '1000.5'); null when not stated.
conversion: checks_jsonb {field: {state, value}} -> checks[]; list values are joined with ', '. tax_basis is returned top-level and not repeated in checks.
cost_terms_jsonb.items -> costs[]; basis, payer and evidence location are not exposed.
evidence_jsonb {field: {raw_value, mail_id, location}} -> evidence[]; entries without mail_id are omitted.
checks and evidence follow the extractor field order (app.agents.tools.QUOTE_FIELDS); unknown fields follow by name.
response.supplier_name: Current suppliers.name; '이름 미확인 업체' when the supplier row is missing.
response.is_incumbent: Supplier linked to the case's initial (price-increase) mail; falls back to the supplier whose quote came from the initial mail.

selection: One item per supplier: the highest version_no. Older versions are not returned (history view not agreed).
ordering: Incumbent first, then supplier_name, then supplier_id.
paging: None. At most 100 suppliers and 500 stored quote rows per case; exceeding either returns 503 instead of a truncated list.
empty: A case without quotes returns 200 with items: [].

errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: 404: case missing or outside the owner scope
errors.PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: 503: storage unavailable, stored JSON shape invalid, or the row/supplier caps exceeded

open_with_frontend: Whether older quote versions are needed (e.g. an all_versions query option).
available_quantity_unit (pricing_terms_jsonb.available_quantity_unit) is not in the agreed spec; add only after the spec changes.
